description: Swap any token for any token from the caller's OWN wallet: returns the exact unsigned transaction (EVM tx dict or base64 Solana tx) for that wallet to sign and broadcast. Non-custodial — no key leaves the user, nothing is held, no ledger, no identity step; the wallet is the account. Chains: GET /api/v1/swap/chains; tokens: GET /api/v1/swap/tokens/{chain_id} (Solana is chain_id 501). Platform fee: GET /api/v1/promo/status (0% while the promo runs); the user pays chain gas. Tickers (USDC, ETH, SOL) or contract/mint addresses are accepted. When an ERC-20 sell needs allowance, `approval` carries the exact approve tx to sign first. Optionally record the signed tx in swap history with POST /api/v1/swap/broadcast (X-API-Key).
